message.reasoning_content:
We need answer only JSON. Need evaluate every story PP-001 to PP-053 for Atomic criterion. Need be careful. Need output valid JSON exactly 53 objects. Need decide Violation/No Violation for each. Need evidence concise. Need rationale criterion-specific. Need related_story_ids [] unless set-level? This is individual, so probably empty. But maybe for some decisions related? No, atomic at individual. Need maybe no related. Confidence.

We need evaluate each story: does it combine two or more independently implementable/testable/prioritizable features? Do not flag conjunctions enumerating attributes of one feature.

Let's go through all.

Backlog PlanningPoker.

Need parse each story for multiple features. Need decide binary. Atomic = exactly one feature. User story format role, want, so. Many start "As moderator, I want to X and Y". Conjunction may indicate two features. But some are compound feature.

We need assess each individually. Could identify violations where two or more distinct features in one story. Let's review.

PP-001: "As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description, so that I can start inviting estimators."
Features: create game by entering name and optional description. Entering name and optional description are attributes of game creation. Not separate features. No violation. (Maybe optional description attribute). Atomic ok.

PP-002: "As a moderator, I want to invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game, so that we can start the game." Single feature invite by URL. No violation.

PP-003: "As a moderator, I want to start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field, so that we can estimate it." Single feature start round with item entry. Entering item is part. No violation.

PP-004: "As a moderator, I want to see all items we try to estimate this session, so that I can answer questions about the current story such as "does this include ___"." Single feature see all items. No violation.

PP-005: "As a moderator, I want to select an item to be estimated or re-estimated, so that the team sees that item and can estimate it." Single feature select item. "estimated or re-estimated" same operation. No violation.

PP-006: "As a moderator, I want to add an item to the list of items to be estimated, so that so that we can be flexible and accommodate situations where we think of a new story while playing." Typo "so that so that". Single add item. ok.

PP-007: "As a moderator, I want to edit an item in the list of items to be estimated, so that I can make it better reflect the team's understanding of the item." Single edit. ok.

PP-008: delete item single. ok.

PP-009: "As a moderator, I want to show all estimates immediately, so that I can decide to show the estimates that have been given even though not all estimators have given their estimate." Single show all estimates immediately. ok.

PP-010: "As a moderator, I want to accept the average of all estimates, so that we can move on to the next item when we agree." Single accept average. ok.

PP-011: "As a moderator, I want to have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card, so that I can accept it more quickly." Single auto-fill estimate based on consensus. ok.

PP-012: "As a moderator, I want to enter the agreed-upon estimate, so that we can move on to the next item when we agree." Single enter estimate. ok.

PP-013: "As a moderator, I want to estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again, so that we can give a new estimate if we feel different about the story after estimating other related stories." Single re-estimate. ok.

PP-014: "As a moderator, I want to import stories from a spreadsheet, so that I don't have to copy and paste each individual story." Single import. ok.

PP-015: "As a moderator, I want to copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet, so that I can get started more quickly." Single copy/paste import? Could be similar to PP-014 but separate story. Single feature. ok.

PP-016: "As a moderator, I want to browse through previous games, so that I can find the previous game I'm looking for." Single browse/search. ok.

PP-017: "As a moderator, I want to view a transcript of a game, so that I can see the stories and estimates." Single view transcript. ok.

PP-018: "As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a HTML file, so that I can save the stories and estimates locally." Single export HTML. ok.

PP-019: "As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a CSV file, so that I can further process the stories and estimates." Single export CSV. ok. Maybe PP-018 and PP-019 are different formats, each atomic.

PP-020: "As a moderator, I want to delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored." Single delete. ok.

PP-021: "As a moderator, I want to create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username, so that I can start using the application." Single create account; entering multiple fields are attributes. No violation. Even though multiple fields. ok.

PP-022: "As a moderator, I want to log in using my account name and password, so that I can start using the application." Single login with credentials. ok.

PP-023: "As a moderator, I want to change my account details, so that I can keep my account details up-to-date." Single change details. ok.

PP-024: "As a moderator, I want to delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored." Single delete account. Note consequence deletes games, not feature. ok.

PP-025: "As a moderator, I want to see dates and times in my local timezone, so that I don't have to do timezone conversion myself." Single timezone display. ok.

PP-026: "As a moderator, I want to get a password reminder by email, so that I can get back to using the application when I've forgotten my password." Single password reminder. ok.

PP-027: "As a moderator, I want to select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}, so that the team can use either the modified Fibonacci sequence or powers of 2." Single feature choose scale. Two options not separate features, just choices. ok.

PP-028: "As a moderator, I want to invite up to 15 estimators, so that we can play with large but not immense teams." Single limit on invites. Could be attribute of invite? But story-level single feature (constraint). ok.

PP-029: "As an estimator, I want to join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for, so that I can participate." Single join game. ok.

PP-030: "As an estimator, I want to see the item we're estimating, so that I know what I'm giving an estimate for." Single display item. ok.

PP-031: "As an estimator, I want to see all items we will try to estimate this session, so that I have a feel for the sizes of the various items." Single list. ok.

PP-032: "As a participant, I want to immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator, so that I know who has already given an estimate and who we're still waiting for." Single see indicator estimate given. ok.

PP-033: "As a participant, I want to be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate, so that I can be sure estimates are independent and not influenced by other estimates given in the same draw." Single display all estimates simultaneously. ok.

PP-034: "As a participant, I want to be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown, so that I can change my mind based on information I hear." Single change estimate. ok.

PP-035: "As a participant, I want to be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated, so that I can see how his or her opinion has changed so I can ask questions." Single see prior estimates. ok.

PP-036: "As a participant, I want to see who gave what estimates during the current round, so that I know this when we're discussing the estimates." Single see who gave what. ok.

PP-037: "As a participant, I want to be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see, so that I can limit the time spent discussing the estimates when I think we've talked long enough." Single start shared timer. ok.

PP-038: "As a participant, I want to have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate, so that it's ready for use on the next round." Single timer auto-reset. ok.

PP-039: "As a participant, I want to scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds, so that I can use this information when I estimate the item of the current round." Single scroll back/history. ok.

PP-040: "As a participant, I want to always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws, so that it's easy to compare estimates." Single consistent card order. ok.

PP-041: "As a participant, I want to change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed, so that I can change my mind." Single change estimate. Note overlaps PP-034. Atomic independently. ok.

PP-042: "As a participant, I want to have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played, so that the game is more personal because I see who I'm estimating with." Single avatar display. ok.

PP-043: "As a developer, I want to have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards, so that as many people as possible can access the site and view it as intended." Single compliance. XHTML and CSS are standards maybe attribute? Single feature. But phrase "XHTML and CSS" two standards? It's one feature: compliance with two related standards. Does not combine independent features. No violation. Need consider if "compliant with XHTML and CSS" could be two validations but still one feature? Operational says do not flag conjunctions that enumerate attributes of one feature. This is one feature "standards compliance". ok.

PP-044: "As a developer, I want to have a list of definitions for commonly used terms, so that everyone working on the project can understand each other more easily." Single glossary. ok.

PP-045: "As a developer, I want to have created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible." Single performance optimization. ok.

PP-046: "As a developer, I want to have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2, so that as many people as possible can fully use the application." Single cross-browser compatibility. Multiple browsers enumerated but one feature. no violation.

PP-047: "As a developer, I want to have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible, so that people with accessibility issues can use the application." Single accessibility compliance. ok.

PP-048: "As a user, I want to have the application respond quickly to my actions, so that I don't get bored." Single performance responsiveness. ok.

PP-049: "As a user, I want to be able to use Unicode, so that I can use any language I like." Single Unicode support. ok.

PP-050: "As a user, I want to see sensible and predictable URLs, so that the application feels logical and transparent." Single URL design. ok.

PP-051: "As a user, I want to have nice error pages when something goes wrong, so that I can trust the system and its developers." Single error pages. ok.
